propositions: A stale clone with mismatched or absent epoch must refuse to union at sync._union_merge and return without merging, leaving both refs unchanged and the clone un-converged.
A stale clone reaching push.py's non-fast-forward retry path with epoch mismatch must return immediately without merge or re-push, terminating the retry loop and surfacing the push as not-completed.

The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string compared only for byte equality; any mismatch, corrupt value (non-string), or absent-vs-present mismatch triggers abort with a descriptive warning log.
Remote .store-compat.json must be read via git show <remote_ref>, distinguishing ref-unreadable errors from file-absent in the log message to guide operator recovery.

A clone with matching epochs or compatible absence patterns (both absent, or both record-present-epoch-absent) must converge normally; behind clones must still fast-forward and strictly-ahead clones must return early.
